name: Gallows Remnant
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

abilities.name: Fear Aura
abilities.description: The remnant emanates an aura in a 20-foot radius while it is not incapacitated. Any enemy that starts its turn in the aura must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.

abilities.name: Smother (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The remnant smothers one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While smothered, the target is blinded and restrained, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remnant, and takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the remnant's turns. The remnant can have only one creature smothered at a time. If the remnant takes 15 damage or more in a single turn from the smothered creature, the remnant must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the remnant. If the remnant dies, a smothered creature pulls free prone by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The remnant makes two Stranglecord attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Hangman's Heave.

actions.name: Stranglecord
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Hangman's Heave
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 5 feet straight toward the remnant and be knocked prone.

condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

generation.userConcept: a hangman's rope that remembers every neck
generation.cite: composition after Giant Crocodile (CR 5) jaws + Giant Toad (CR 1) swallow — print swallows at LOW CR
